visualCharacteristics.purpose: list of frozen last-minute flight deals, each row one link with a bold price, partly revealed by a Show more button
traits: no header row, 1px row separators, no zebra
whole row is a link with a trailing arrow
origin, destination and date on the left, bold price on the right
first N rows visible, Show more button reveals the rest
stacks origin/destination/date beside the price below 900px

contentPattern.structure: One row per deal, no header row, 4 cells: Origin | Destination | Date | Price (cells map to these columns by position; extra cells render below as extra text, missing cells leave the column empty). The first link found in any cell of the row becomes the whole-row link (rel=nofollow; links inside cells are unwrapped); a row without a link renders as plain text. Optional config rows with exactly 2 cells, before or after the deals, are never rendered as deals: 'Visible rows | 5' (number of rows shown before the button, default 5) and 'Show more label | Show more' (defaults: EN 'Show more', DE 'Mehr anzeigen'). The Show more button reveals all remaining rows and is omitted when all rows are visible. Empty rows are ignored. Prices and dates are authored text

usage.description: 'Last-minute deals' list on AirCore destination pages (frozen at import).

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of linked route/price rows where each row is one link. For key/value data without links use table-striped; for live prices use fare-teaser.
